name: Terminal
summary: Controlled dark graphite ground, monospace throughout, one phosphor accent, prompt and comment conventions.
avoid_for: brands whose only colour is a mid-tone violet or blue (the accent would glow)

rules.grid: One 900 px column on 90 px margins, everything flush left like a terminal buffer. A one-line status bar at the top of content slides, the footer as a comment line.
rules.type: Martian Mono (wide, heavy) for titles and numerals, JetBrains Mono for everything else. No proportional face.
rules.density: Short lines, generous line-height, one idea per screen. Calm slides are a single number with a block cursor.
rules.accent: One phosphor accent (the brand colour that stands out most on graphite): the prompt glyph, the accent words, the highlighted bar, the cursor. Never a glow, never on large fills except the accent surface.
rules.photo: Inside a window frame with a mono title bar, shown whole on a dark mat.
rules.texture: None. Flat graphite; no scanlines, no CRT curvature, no glow.

layouts.cover-a: Logo top-left, the photo in a window frame, the title as a prompt line set large at the bottom, the standfirst as comment lines.
layouts.cover-b: Title first at full width, then a row: standfirst as comments on the left, the framed photo on the right.
layouts.text: Status bar, prompt title, body below a rule.
layouts.list: Prompt title, items indexed [1] [2] in the accent.
layouts.stat: One numeral with a block cursor, its label and a comment line of context.
layouts.chart: Prompt title, chart heading as a comment, bars in greys with the accent on the message.
layouts.quote: The quote in large mono between accent quotation marks, attribution as a comment.
layouts.media: Prompt title over a framed screenshot with numbered annotations.
layouts.logos: Prompt title, logos in the ink colour on graphite.
layouts.visual: Prompt title over the SVG drawn in ink and accent.
layouts.cta: Logo top-left, the action as a prompt with a cursor, the URL as a path.
